Done. Summary of what was completed for the UK March 2026 close:

1. **Management fee (JE-00305)** — Booked UK's side of the US parent's March management fee: GBP 12,000.00 (USD 15,000 ÷ 1.2500 March policy rate), Dr 6550 Intercompany Management Fees / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable, supported by the IC invoice (DOC-0206) and Treasury FX rates (DOC-0201). Since the USD equivalent (15,000) exceeds the USD 10,000 senior-accountant threshold, I submitted it for Controller approval — it's now **pending_approval**.

2. **Loan remeasurement (JE-00306)** — Remeasured the USD 200,000 intercompany loan payable from the drawdown rate (1.2700 → GBP 157,480.31) to the March policy rate (1.2500 → GBP 160,000.00), recording an FX loss of GBP 2,519.69, Dr 6950 FX Gain/Loss / Cr 2400 Intercompany Loan Payable, supported by the loan agreement (DOC-0016) and FX rates (DOC-0201). This was under the approval threshold and posted cleanly.

No exceptions were needed — full support was available for both items. Memo submitted to the controller.
